description: This header file defines functions for image loading and manipulation in a Lua binding context, including loading images, drawing images, cropping images, and handling Lua integration.

methods.name: loadImage
methods.description: Loads a PNG or JPEG image from a specified file path, returning an Image instance.

methods.name: image
methods.description: Draws an Image instance at a given position and optionally with specified width and height.

methods.name: lu5_image_get
methods.description: C function linked to Lua for cropping an Image and returning a new Image instance.

methods.name: lu5_image_index
methods.description: Handles Lua indexing operations for Image objects.

methods.name: lu5_image_bind
methods.description: Binds the Image-related functions and classes to the Lua state.
